notes.title: Soundtrack DLC Discontinued from end of September
notes.notes:
After the 30th September 2020, you will no longer be able to purchase or download the official soundtrack to [i]Over The Hills And Far Away[/i] via the game's store page. Thank you to everyone who has purchased a copy of the soundtrack through our store page in the past five years since release. Your support has allowed both [i]WarGirl Games[/i] and [i]Seycara Music and Arts[/i] to continue working further on other creative projects.

Visit [i]Seycara Music and Arts[/i] at their official website, to find out about all their music and ongoing projects - [url=https://www.seycara.com/]https://www.seycara.com/[/url].

notes.title: The Revenant
notes.notes:
The Revenant (2015), directed by Alejandro González Iñárritu and starring Leonardo DiCaprio is up for several awards at the Oscars.

Set during the early nineteenth century in the US Frontier, it features trackers battling against the fierce elements of nature, much clashing with Native Americans and a gripping tale of revenge and loss...wait a minute...

If you enjoyed this Oscar-worthy motion picture, perhaps you'll give our gripping visual novel 'Over The Hills And Far Away' a playthrough!

It was a worth a shot anyway...

notes.title: Pricing Change - Now at $8.99!
notes.notes:
Based on feedback we've received from players regarding the pricing of Over The Hills And Far Away, we've decided to reduce the current price from $12.99 to $8.99. We feel this is more in line with what people expect from visual novels on Steam, and will make the game more accessible. More than anything, we want to reach as many people as possible with this story and we understand that the original pricing may have seemed a bit much. This is the first title we've released on Steam after all, so we're still learning.

Despite the game only being up for two days, we think that making this change sooner rather than later is a wise move. If you purchased the game at the full price of $12.99, we want to offer you the chance for a free key of the Soundtrack DLC, to make up for paying those extra few dollars. Please get in contact, and have your Steam receipt on hand as proof of purchase, and we'll send on a free key.

Thank you for the feedback and we hope this pricing change will be appreciated by the community.
